releases.notes:
# God Dices — alpha release. *The dice have awakened. Fate no longer belongs to chance.*
--- ## General * Added the **_God's Dices._** 🎲 * Added the **_Dark Sister._** 🗡 * Added the **_Venom Pickaxe._** ⛏️ * Added the **_Venom Ore,_** that used to craft previous items. * The weapon's abilities now depend on the _current face_ of the dice. * Added _teleport-based story mod_. --- ## God Dices 🎲 The God Dices now grants different powers depending on its current face. ### Face I — Blink * Teleports the player to the block player are looking at. * Grants temporary movement speed while charging. * Grants Slow Falling after cast. * Added story-mode based on count of teleports. --- ### Face II — Wealth * Apply a bone meal on block player looking at. * Grants health and saturation after cast. --- ### Face III - Secrets * Not implemented > *"Every fallen soul strengthens the blade."* --- ### Face IV - Strength * Grants you ability to crush blocks while jumping --- ### Face V - Strike * Releases a light strike on to the block player are looking at after cast. * Damages every enemy in AOE. * Added magical particle trail. --- ### Face VI - Wounds * Not implemented --- ### Dark Sister 🗡 A spectral katana empowered by the God Dice. * Base Attack Damage is now 15. * Vampirism mechanics with overhealing * Added custom combat behavior. * Added powerful right-click abilities depends on dice's face. ### Venom Piackaxe ⛏️ * Literally is just pickaxe. Or not?... ### Venom Ore🗡 * Spawns underground. Used to craft mod items. --- ## Visual Effects * Added new magical particle combinations. * Added lightning effects. * Added portal effects. * Added enchanted hit effects. * Improved ability readability during combat. --- ## Technical * Improved server-side combat handling. * Optimized particle spawning. * Improved multiplayer compatibility. * Refactored ability handling. * Added new event-based combat systems. --- ## Known Issues * Temporary bonus health currently disappears instantly when its duration expires. * Additional God Dice faces are still under development. * More Divine Weapons are planned. --- *"Roll the Dice. Rewrite Reality."*
